llm.summary: This skill is a legitimate here.now publishing and cloud-storage helper, but users should treat publishing, Drive storage, and stored credentials as real external actions.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe Sites for public live URLs and Drives for private persistent cloud files, and the scripts implement those workflows against here.now APIs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Invocation phrases include broad intents such as generating a URL or storing something for later, so agents should confirm what content will be uploaded or published before acting.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed as an npx skills add command; the artifact contains shell helper scripts but no hidden package installation or obfuscated installer behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network use, local file reads for selected upload paths, and API calls are proportionate to publishing and Drive storage; public Sites and remote Drive persistence carry expected data-exposure risk.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill stores API keys in ~/.herenow/credentials and publish state in .herenow/state.json, auto-uses stored credentials, and supports scoped Drive sharing and deletion; these are disclosed but require care.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want agents to upload selected files or folders to here.now, create public Site URLs, store private files in remote Drives, and use a saved here.now API key. Confirm before publishing sensitive material, prefer short-lived scoped Drive tokens, and review ~/.herenow/credentials and .herenow/state.json as sensitive local files.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Shell commands and network requests are expected for a hosting/storage skill, and requirements plus helper scripts are disclosed in SKILL.md.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases are relevant to publishing and storage, but users should ensure agents do not interpret vague sharing requests as permission to upload sensitive content.
[SQP-2] expected: Sites are described as live URLs at here.now, which supports the publishing purpose; an even clearer public-web warning would improve user understanding.
[SQP-2] expected: Auto-loading ~/.herenow/credentials is explicitly documented and supports permanent authenticated publishing, though it can change an anonymous publish into an account-backed action.
[E1] expected: Sending an email address to request a sign-in code is part of the documented authentication flow and occurs after asking the user for their email.
[RA2] expected: Persistent Drive storage and agent-to-agent sharing are core advertised features; the skill also advises narrow path prefixes and short TTLs for shared tokens.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean with no malicious or suspicious engine detections.
[staticScan] expected: The platform static scan reported no suspicious patterns.
